title: "I've been warning y'all...since 2014": Miranda Lambert breaks silence on viral miniskirt mishap - NewsBreak
text: Miranda Lambert is one of those artists who never seems to care about what others think and that’s exactly why people love her. Recently, during a concert in Seattle, a video of her went viral for a pretty funny reason. While performing, her denim miniskirt rode up a little more than usual, and the internet noticed. Instead of hiding or getting embarrassed, Miranda Lambert did what she does best she owned it with confidence and a sense of humor. The viral moment happened at Lumen Field, where Miranda was on stage wearing a simple but stylish outfit. She had on a black T-shirt with some leather fringe, tied at the waist, and a blue denim miniskirt with a brown leather belt and a cowboy hat. Pretty classic Miranda style. Instead of ignoring it, Miranda made a TikTok response video wearing the same outfit, apparently before going on stage. She used her 2014 song Little Red Wagon in the background, which includes the lyric: Over the video, she wrote: ​ A fan took a TikTok video during the Seattle show, and it zoomed in close enough to catch the bottom of Miranda’s skirt riding up, showing a bit of her backside. The fan captioned it: The video quickly caught attention and was shared a lot online. Miranda in response to the viral video said that she has been warning the audiences about her "backyard swagger since 2014." ​ Her response perfectly showed she’s proud of who she is and not bothered by a little unexpected attention. Fans loved her reaction and praised her for owning the moment without hesitation. Comments under her video were full of support. This should be no shock to anyone who's been familiar with Miranda Lambert for a while. She's never been reserved when it comes to body confidence and the importance of not letting insecurities get the best of you. In an interview prior, she informed us that worrying about her body while performing was distracting and took away from her performance. She said the secret to it all for her was being confident in herself no matter what. This whole viral skirt moment is just such a great reflection of Miranda's personality. Instead of being concerned with what people might think, she owns her "backyard swagger" and makes it part of her story. ​ ​
